items.text: Ask the scolarité office for a certificate of enrolment.

input.brief: Ask for a certificate of enrolment for the visa appointment on Thursday 3 December. No language named: use the language of the request (English). Tone: administration.

draft.subject: Request for a certificate of enrolment
draft.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Could you please issue a certificate of enrolment (certificat de scolarité) for me? I need it for my visa appointment on Thursday 3 December.

Thank you in advance.

Kind regards,
Tom Okafor
